# Interim game art

These packs are temporary 2D placeholder art. Final potato characters, habitat modules, map tiles, and cutscenes should replace these files as they are drawn.

| Pack | Source | License | In-game use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kenney Planets | https://kenney.nl/assets/planets | CC0 1.0 | Earth, Moon, and Mars views in the Phaser travel sequence and habitat windows. |
| Kenney Simple Space | https://kenney.nl/assets/simple-space | CC0 1.0 | Small spacecraft sprite in the launch sequence. |
| Kenney Sci-Fi RTS | https://kenney.nl/assets/sci-fi-rts | CC0 1.0 | Small landing habitat sprite in the launch sequence. |

The original source ZIPs and each pack's `License.txt` are stored beside this file. Kenney states that its assets may be used in commercial projects without attribution; attribution is optional. The selected runtime images are in `public/assets/placeholders/kenney/`.

The suggested Free Pixel Sci-Fi Tileset and Cozy Space Lite downloads are not included. Their asset pages describe permissive commercial-use terms, but itch.io redirected the anonymous download requests to a login page in this environment. They can be added later from downloaded ZIPs if preferred.
